notes: Auth: the firebase CLI login (a project owner), so beginTransaction gives a PESSIMISTIC read-write transaction and security rules do not apply; end-user behaviour is not recorded here.
Times, durations and transaction ids are replaced by placeholders (normalise in lib.mjs, and the replace maps of record-f2.mjs); everything else is as returned.

Transaction ids are replaced by numbered placeholders naming how each was made (<read-write transaction #1> and so on); the fixed made-up ids (16 bytes 00112233…ff, one byte 0x07, 1000 bytes 0x5a) stay as sent. idBytes is the length of a returned id.
aruma-ref-f2-txn/a, b and c are written by the setup commit.

lifetime: six transactions begun at the same moment: idle_70s_then_plain_write read e5, after 70 s idle a commit without transaction wrote e5, then the transaction committed a write of e5; idle_271s_read_write read e6, read it again after 271 s idle, then committed; idle_read_write read e1 and committed after 300 s idle; busy_read_write read e2 every 30 s and committed at 300 s; idle_read_only read e3 again after 300 s; idle_blind_read_write read nothing and committed a write after 300 s. atSeconds is from the begin.

versions.api: firestore.googleapis.com REST v1 and gRPC google.firestore.v1.Firestore
